# Ohuhu

> > Ohuhu is a premium art supplies brand specializing in dual-tip alcohol and water-based markers, offering curated collections across multiple series designed for artists and creators.

Ohuhu provides a comprehensive catalog of professional-grade markers organized by series (Honolulu, Oahu, Kaala, Molokai, and Maui) alongside complementary drawing supplies including papers, pens, and paints. The site serves a global audience with regional warehouses across the US, EU, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and Australia.

## Key Topics

- Alcohol-based markers
- Water-based markers
- Dual-tip markers
- Honolulu Series
- Oahu Series
- Kaala Series
- Maui Series
- Molokai Series
- Color sets
- Individual markers
- Drawing supplies
- Art papers
- Marker pads
- Non-toxic formulas
- Professional art supplies

## Marker Collections

- [Markers – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/markers): Main markers collection featuring alcohol and water-based markers
- [Alcohol-based Markers – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/alcohol-based-markers): Alcohol-based markers collection with Honolulu and Oahu series
- [Water-based Markers – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/water-based-markers): Water-based markers collection including Maui series

## Marker Series

- [Honolulu Series – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/honolulu-series): Honolulu Series alcohol art markers with dual-tip precision
- [Oahu Series – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/oahu-series): Oahu Series alcohol markers in multiple color sets
- [Maui Series – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/maui-series): Maui Series water-based dual-tip art markers
- [Kaala Series – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/kaala-series): Kaala Series dual-tip alcohol markers with varied color options
- [Molokai Series – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/molokai-series): Molokai Series with extra-wide tip alcohol art markers

- [Oahu Individual Series – Ohuhu](https://ohuhu.com/collections/oahu-individual-series): Oahu Individual Series alcohol markers with fine chisel tips
